motionContract.intent: Readable seated arms-up chest/back stretch and exhaled release beyond a shoulder shrug
motionContract.primaryMotion:
for Umi's identity, original colors, face/head/paw/arm proportions and grounded neutral opening and neutral ending. IMAGE2 supplies ONLY the intermediate arms-up seated STRETCH intention. It is not the starting pose, ending pose or permission to lengthen the arms, enlarge the head or change materials. Retain the original compact anatomy through the movement.

Umi takes ONE satisfying full seated stretch that clearly RELEASES tension through his upper back and chest. After only0.1–0.25seconds of brief natural breath/shoulder anticipation, immediately begin the ONE connected stretch, reaching the clear arms-up extension around0.5seconds from the clip opening. Do not sit waiting in neutral for the first second or more. The chest opens and rises, the upper back lengthens and the shoulders/neck respond as BOTH thick furry forearms lift naturally into IMAGE2's readable upward V stretch, with elbows comfortably opening, short full round paws rising above shoulder level and softly grouped animal toes. This must be a recognizable torso-and-arms stretch, not only lifting the palms a few centimeters, shrugging the shoulders or nodding the head. The same supported impulse flows through chest, back, neck, shoulders, elbows and wrists together, without demonstrating one body part at a time. The lower seated base stays grounded throughout: ONLY the two existing front paws lift; do not invent any additional feet or lower paws.

Make the gathering and extension comfortable at normal everyday speed, around0.3–0.5seconds for the extension after that short anticipation, not slow motion. A SHORT living ease at the clear arms-up peak carries a small breath, continuous closed-eye smile lines and separate gray bean brows. This is stretching, not waving or cheering: do not alternate or shake either raised paw, do not pump the arms repeatedly, no new excited mouth or huge yawn. Then a prompt visible soft exhale releases the raised shoulders and chest and naturally lowers BOTH arms back to the original paired planted paws of IMAGE1. Let the return finish with breathing life and the same open blue star eyes/tiny closed smile, not a frozen endpoint or reversed stretch.

Both gray palms remain short, broad, round and full, with four SHORT grouped rounded animal toe volumes, original little pink toe beans and one lobed central pad when the palms are visible, tiny ivory nails and short sturdy wrists. Keep the full WHITE forearms and original pointed gray/white fur boundary; no long gray wrist columns, long human fingers, shrinking hands, extra toe rows or detached pads. Maintain original head/face width and overall body proportions while the torso changes pose; no whole-picture scaling to fake the stretch. The seated lower root and ONE heavy cape hem stay at their original ground support, narrow downward corners never lifted sideways into wings, horizontal points or new sleeve flaps. Upper collar folds, a small scarf/folded-ear after-settle may follow the same chest release. Keep the camera/logical registration fixed and the backdrop EXACTLY flat unlit #A020C0 for all four seconds, no scene/hue change or colored reflection. Begin and end in IMAGE1's neutral supported pose as the acting intent, without forced frame paste, slow drifting, snap or replay backwards.
